blocks.text: Digital platforms sehat ki taleem, telemedicine aur appointment ki sahoolat dete hain. Rasai na ho to log waqt par maloomat aur ilaj der se pate, jis se sehat ke nataij kharab hote hain; kam internet wali Pakistani dehi biradariyan motabar sehat maloomat dhoondne ya telemedicine mashwaron mein mushkil paati hain.

blocks.prompt: Telemedicine kya hai, aur digital divide ise kyun mehdood karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Internet ya phone video par doctor se mashwara; rabte aur aale ke baghair mareez ise istemal nahi kar sakta.

items: Sehat ka farq: sehat maloomat aur telemedicine tak kam rasai.
